<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Basic Actions
</COLOR>
　Move your Rider with  and attack with .

　<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Normal Attack

</COLOR> /  / +　<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Special Moves

　</COLOR>Some moves become combos when input repeatedly,
　and some change their attack.
b382000ecb:
<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Tag Partner
</COLOR>
　While your tag partner is on the battlefield, the
　<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Voltage Gauge</COLOR> in the top left rises over time.

　When it reaches <COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>25%</COLOR>, <COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>50%</COLOR> and <COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>75%</COLOR>, bonus effects
　activate and power up the player.

　<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Attacking enemies together near your tag partner</COLOR>
　makes the gauge rise faster.
7439980516:
++　<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Double Rider Finish
</COLOR>
　Usable when the Voltage Gauge is at <COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>100%</COLOR>.
　Temporarily raises attack and slows enemies.

　When the gauge at the bottom runs out, you unleash a
　<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Double Rider Kick</COLOR> and the power-up ends.

　<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Input it again before the gauge runs out</COLOR>
　to unleash the Double Rider Kick early.
50d7ffc57f:
+ / + / +　<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Tag Requests
</COLOR>
　Spend 10% of the Voltage Gauge to have
　your tag partner attack.

+　<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Mode Change</COLOR>

　<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Attack </COLOR>Attacks the same enemy as the player.
　<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Guard</COLOR>　Keeps guarding against enemy attacks.
　<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Support </COLOR>Helps when the player is attacked.

Tap the screen　<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Lock On</COLOR> ( up/down to change target)

　<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Finisher</COLOR>

　Use it with <COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>50% or more finisher gauge</COLOR> to change
　into your strongest form or state and unleash powerful
　attacks. The change ends when the gauge runs out.

 in strongest form/state　<COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>Ultimate Change</COLOR>

　After changing with <COLOR=0x6EDC00FF>100% finisher gauge</COLOR>, input it

</COLOR>

　appears above it. Hit it with a special move to defeat it.
